bluesky.text:
Some people learn AI tools to stay current. Others learn AI to develop a different way of thinking.

What they learn might be obsolete in months. They do it anyway — not for the knowledge, but for the instinct it builds.

And it compounds.

https://substack.com/@joseantoniomorales/note/c-230090026

AI is everywhere new content is created — we can feel the standardization spreading. Same as when filters took over Instagram photos. How are we gonna keep our art when everyone rushes to be standard?

https://substack.com/@joseantoniomorales/note/c-265104548

I take Claude similarly to working with a human assistant, imperfect, well-intentioned, and always improving.

But now more than ever, Claude helps me learn and build software and automations that I would not be able to do by myself so efficiently.

A new app helps EU funding applicants write better proposals.
The same app scores those proposals for the evaluators.

When the coach and the judge are the same system — what exactly is being measured?

https://substack.com/profile/17146826-jose-antonio-morales/note/c-265851491

Today I saved half the time I usually spend preparing for a client workshop.

All my articles, drafts, and presentations in one place, retrieved with Claude's assistance. I just don't have such a memory.

https://automato.substack.com/p/ai-assisted-knowledge-management-4u
